description: Returns the exact current date, time, weekday and UTC offset in any time zone. Use this whenever you need to know today's date or the current time instead of guessing — your training data does not know what day it is.

timezone.description: IANA time zone name, e.g. "America/New_York", "Europe/London", "Asia/Tokyo", or "UTC". Fixed offsets like "UTC+5:30" also work.

name: current_time
title: Current date and time
